rule.statement: A court can correct an arithmetical mistake in a partition action without reconsidering the merits of the judgment.
rule.supporting_quote: Such an error could and should have been corrected by the District Court in terms of section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code read with section 79 of the Partition Law.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code read with section 79 of the Partition Law
